notes.title: New Species! Common Blue Butterfly Lifecycle!
notes.content:
Dear players!

It is time to celebrate! A Beautiful New Blue Butterfly is in your midst!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/b67311f8e5b15b2f0daa46af440c0345749c6965.jpg[/img]

The Common Blue Butterfly species has arrived, the first of the game's New Species Content Updates for 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/a0154332c19e0ffaa61035adc37140587ac9b624.jpg[/img]
[i]Immerse yourself into beautiful & fun Courtship & Mating experiences![/i]


Featuring Full Lifecycle from Caterpillar to Pupa to Adult, including Mating & Courtship, this update is a must play for the game's wonderful players!

Read on to learn more! :)

[h1]Common Blue Butterfly Lifecycle[/h1]

This is a very small butterfly compared to the Monarch, so be prepared for a totally new experience!

The Bird's Foot plant is also rather small, providing a completely fresh take on the game's Butterfly Lifecycle experience!

[h2]Egg Stage[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/ee7b83f618a69049517ba0e143d400bc3c999c3b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/e84359f14560f66f1b3a40ce217fb11fc40ddd7e.jpg[/img]

[h2]As Large Caterpillar![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/ea7e001cc31f56bdb9d3784d279e77161fe9e11f.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Plant - Bird's Foot![/h2]
The new species comes with its beautiful hostplant - "The Bird's Foot"! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/5ab91de064729b8c6d958ee58f1279c1c5f3d0a4.jpg[/img]
[i]Bird's Foot Meadow Of Flowers! (made with "Create & Design Nature" mode) [/i]
[h2] Metamorphosis into Adult![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/58778c56431802664ec356ab926886438ea56cc4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Courtship[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/21dee5be455b2261bcd5e31e24b681c59204d2c5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Mating[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/20523df92b39c00b86e7ccbf7da64f8ab00fa641.jpg[/img]


[h1]Play it for yourself![/h1]
This is an update that fans of the game should absolutely not miss, so do take the time to play it now :)

The "Common Blue Butterfly" marks the first of the game's Species Content Updates for 2025, but as always there more to come.

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
Thanks as always to the game's wonderful players!

I sincerely hope that you enjoy this update and have fun with our beloved new Common Blue Butterfly!

Thank you :)

With Love,
- Venugopalan Sreedharan
[i]Developer of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/02638aea47d9ac97dd3edde938e3eaa545f41536.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 2025 Trailer & New Roadmap for Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar!
notes.content:
Dear Wonderful Players!

A new 2025 trailer is out for Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar, do check it out below!

Read further on to learn about the game's 2025 roadmap as well :)

[h1]2025 Trailer for Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar[/h1]

[previewyoutube=6OR-Iorg0W8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]2025 Roadmap: What's next for the game[/h1]

[h2]New Content: Subspecies, Plants, Environment[/h2]
This update will add more varieties of each major species (Butterfly, Mantis, Jumping Spider, etc) for giving players greater variety, color and interesting experiences.

Alongside fauna, more plants and trees will also be added, giving players a more interesting and beautiful environment in which to play as their favorite creatures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/f7c9587d1060f6ffce7875452413b568daf7fc52.jpg[/img]
Finally, the environment itself will be improved - made both larger and more detailed. There is a very exciting update around the corner on this front, so stay tuned for more on this :)

[h2]Sandbox v2: [b]"Create & Design - Nature"[/b][/h2]
A lot of players have expressed interest specifically in the Sandbox mode and its potential.

A vastly improved Sandbox mode, entitled [b]"Create & Design - Nature"[/b] has been planned for a while now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/6a7adff2064a5e78738ba31ef3cdc8bba4f4a3d2.jpg[/img]
This will provide players with complete guidance on how to unleash the full power of the Sandbox mode, emphasizing custom map creation, detailed workflows for handcrafting custom designs, direct control for players over Lighting and Time of Day (eg: choosing a fixed Season and time of day for your Sandbox scenarios instead of having to speed up the time just to reach a new season).

"Create & Design - Nature" will also feature a Scenario Editor - enabling players to share their custom creations on Steam Workshop!

[h2]Making the grand journey from Bug Life to Birds, Reptiles & Mammals[/h2]
The game's nature engine has been designed from ground up to support multiple perspectives and scales.
 Thus, not only the micro-scale undergrowth of First Instar Leafhoppers (tinier than a pinhead!), but also of tree canopies, of meadows, of landscapes and ultimately entire biomes.

While invertebrates have necessarily been the game's sole focus as the foundation of all ecosystems, yet the plan has always been to work upwards towards Birds, Reptiles and Larger mammals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/c1d41fd6531812a0d5eb05d3059d5896d48a549d.jpg[/img]
For the game to reach a larger player base and thus benefit existing players like yourself, I feel that this grand leap needs to be taken soon, as demonstrating the full power of the game's nature engine will be a great way to increase awareness about the game and thus bring in a new generation of players like yourself :)

[h2]Mutliplayer (Exploration, Survival, Face Off)[/h2]
Multiplayer is indeed another key milestone for the game's roadmap.

Sharing your nature experiences together in a single game world will be truly game changing indeed!

While the first version will necessarily focus on the simpler game modes like "Free Exploration", "Survival" or "Face Off" (this will make it practical to deliver a good experience for players on time), there is pretty much unlimited potential for fun in this space!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/d0eb38b139339fb0fd1f9f0e4a9b037710648dfe.jpg[/img]

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
Thanks as always to the game's wonderful players for your support and inspiration!

Everything that can be done to bring a Beautiful, Fascinating and Inspiring Nature World to the game's wonderful players is being done.

 With your love and support the game will indeed continue to grow and improve with each passing day!

Thank you!

With Love,
- Venugopalan Sreedharan
[i](Developer of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/e98ce2adeb8dcbbfe5ed91a4eda4d0a737e26e57.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Achievements, Cards, Stats, Cloud Save added!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

This update brings key Steam features that have been requested for by the game's wonderful players for long now!

Steam Achievements, Cards, Stats and Cloud Save have all been added!

Along with these comes several key improvements to the game itself, to help make your experience of enjoying these Steam features much better!

[h1]Steam Achievements[/h1]
Complete all 16 achievements today!

[h3]The Life Of a Monarch" Achievement![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/5a4667bd4920c20281d213ba5493e531b1b0a1be.jpg[/img]
[i]Complete the Monarch Butterfly Male & Female Lifecycles (both of which are different!),[/i]

[h3]"Mantis Metamorphosis" Achievement![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/5b6efcb833373dd9cadb8cab5971ecffd1a53aed.jpg[/img]

The game has been vastly improved to make it easier for players to complete these achievements.

[i]Above: Chemical Vision reworked to make completing the Praying Mantis Lifecycle easier for this![/i]

[h2]Full list of Achievements[/h2]
To view all achievements, launch the game and open the Steam overlay (Shift-Tab)

[h1]Steam Cards[/h1]
Trading Cards have been added at last!

 Monarch Butterfly, Jumping Spider, Praying Mantis, Ladybug and Grasshopper are the five cards that can be collected (along with their foil card equivalents).

Badges that can be crafted include "Wee Sapling" (Level 1), "Swift Climber" (Level 2), "Verdant Riser" (Level 3), "Ready To Bloom" (Level 4), "The Glorious Sun" (Level 5) and "One With Nature" (Foil Badge).

Several Emotions have been made available including:
Monarch Butterfly, Viceroy Butterfly, Blue Mud Dauber, Dragonfly, Ladybird Beetle, Leafhopper and 
Ant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/d6f5713bc7a6f7084778c43d3ea544c8dcad5025.jpg[/img]

[h1]Steam Stats[/h1]
Several interesting Stats have been added to Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar!
These include:
[list]
[*] Nectar Drunk (in milliliters!)
[*] Num Hunts
[*] Num Escapes (from Predator)
[*] Number of Random Maps Generated
[*] Num Lifecycles Completed
[*] Num Moults
[*] Num Spring Survival Completion
[*] Num Items Planted
[*] Num Nature Items consumed (Pollen Grains, Beltian Bodies)
[*] Time spent Painting!
[/list]

Future updates will make it easier for players to track their curious statistics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/ffe15756897786a81d1a7ecda409c50302d39cc4.jpg[/img]
[h3]"Nectar Drunk in milliliters"[/h3]
[i]Above: Nectar trails seen using the new "High Contrast" Chemical Vision![/i]

[h1]Steam Cloud Save[/h1]
Cloud save has now been enabled for DoN!
All your save files will be automatically synced across your computers using Steam's Cloud Save feature. ~
As a reminder, save files are located in the following location:
%localappdata%\DoN\Saved

[h1]Key Improvements for making it easier to complete Achievements[/h1]

[h2]Random Map Generator Improvements[/h2]
Lifecycles now has a new "World Generation" menu allowing players to enter Random Map Seeds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/a6d8daab4ba963e2adda2c7c1e8885a759ce3efb.jpg[/img]

Tooltips with detailed information are now provided to help players not familiar with the concepts of Random map generation and Random Seeds,

As a reminder, players can no longer change the "Ecology Preset" for Lifecycles.

You can still use Custom Ecology Presets for all other modes like Survival Sim / Create & Design - Nature (formerly Nature Sandbox) / Face Off / Free Explore.

[h2]"Regenerate Map" menu for all Game Modes[/h2]
The Pause Menu now includes a new "Regnerate Map" menu which provides players with complete control over how you restart a new game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/92b58584a54862904188e790f4e307e8ad5505b0.jpg[/img]

Players can now choose to either Restart using the same World Seed (effectively regenerating exactly the same map again)
or they can set a new "World Seed" which will produce a completely new map altogether!

If you like a particular random map (eg: something with lakes, rolling meadows, etc) then you can remember that seed and reuse it again in any game mode!
Future updates will make it easier for players to Bookmark and manage your Favorite World Seeds!

[h2]Chem Vision Improved[/h2]
To help players complete your Achievements more easily, Chem Vision has been dramatically improved!

It is now actually helpful in visually tracking prey that you would otherwise have missed.

Particularly indispensable for the Praying Mantis Lifecycle, where you are scouring the vast "Mantis Tree World" for extremely tiny prey.

Unlike the previous chem trails which were hard to see against the game's bright and colorful foreground, the new Chem Vision emphasizes the chem trails by isolating them visually, thus making it easier to find prey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/c28796733d36015ced24b361bc6f57e9c417a7b6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Blue Mud Dauber Survival[/h2]
Spiders are now always tracked so long as they are in range, making it much easier to complete the "Three Nests Three Eggs" quest for the "Sweet Nectar Drinker" achievement!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/626d7d46d4fd3928b82f8db742135b1ec79c3944.jpg[/img]
[i]Blue Mud Dauber Survival Quest, for [b]Sweet Nectar Drinker Achievement[/b] is now much easier to complete and more fun to play![/i]

[h2]Jumping Spider Locomotion & Camera[/h2]
[h3]Achievement Alert! "Only the Agile This Path Can Take"[/h3]

Adult Jumping Spiders now use exactly the same camera system as the tiny instars!

Previously the adults used a very different system that was originally designed for the "Lady Love" Creature Quests.

This in turn means that the "Lady Love" Creature Quest is a lot more fun to play and easier to control.
I managed to beat my all time score (now 38 seconds!) and secured #2 position on the game's leaderboard in just a simple casual run!

[b]Why don't you try out the improved "Lady Love" Creature Quest for yourself, right now! :)[/b]

[h2]Ladybug Creature Quest[/h2]
[h3]Achievement Alert! "The Plants Say Thank You"[/h3]

The Ladybug Creature Quest is now so much more fun to play and easier to complete!

Stamina requirements have been greatly relaxed, allowing players to complete the "Plants Say Thank You" Achievement more easily, for which you need to complete the challenge in under 4 minutes!

Personally I managed to beat my all time best and reach #2 spot on the Leaderboard, just in a quick casual test.

[b]Why don't you try bettering you Leaderboard score right now! :)[/b]

[h2]Engine-level CPU performance improvements for a smoother overall experience[/h2]
This update features core CPU improvements to the underlying engine that should provide a smoother experience for all players across the board.

[h2]HUD[/h2]
This update also features a cleaner HUD and improved fauna icons as well.

Importantly - It is now actually possible to understand the gameplay mechanics - such as how a prey saw/felt/smelt you / etc,  simply by keeping your eye on the HUD's new Fauna Icons!

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
The following bugfixes were made, among several other minor improvements as well
[list]
[*] Random map seeds fixed (was broken in previous build)
[*] Fixes to Benchmark tool
[*] Pause menu duplicate entries fixed (for Praying Mantis Lifecycle "Skip Tutorial")
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/cb2bad835c03f9939ae18e83015bdd25d1154e76.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
Thanks as always to the game's wonderful players for your support and enthusiasm through all these yerars.

It is deeply appreciated!

I sincerely hope that you enjoy this update of the game. Good LucK!

With Love,
Venugopalan Sreedharan
[i]Developer of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/02638aea47d9ac97dd3edde938e3eaa545f41536.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New 3D Menu World Released!
notes.content:
[i]Four are the Rivulets of DoN,
Manifold are their forms within!
To Play Survival / Casual / Fantasy / Design is Fun,
Come now, give these a quick spin![/i]

[previewyoutube=DktoegCV6tE;full][/previewyoutube]

Dear Players, this is the [b]biggest Presentation Update[/b] for Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar yet!

Featuring a new 3D Menu World at the centre, this update brings DoN's various game modes under a single cloud (or four of them to be precise!), with clear guidance for new players.

[b]Survival, Casual, Fantasy and Design[/b] are the Four Quadrants of DoN's new 3D Menu World.

New players will now find it much easier to gain a quick overview of what the game has to offer,
while experienced players will find themselves getting much more out of the game than ever before.

Read on to learn more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/7233d2c0db6187c7a8afd55efb48fa3b2e18e6d0.png[/img]

[h1]Survival Quadrant[/h1]
[b]Lifecycles, Survival Simulation & Face Off[/b] are the game modes under the Survival Quadrant.

The "Menu World" plays a visual skit for each mode as you hover your mouse over the button,
giving players a hint of what to expect within!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/f021e28d17bb38ff8ee518ce7b35b970d2fa410e.png[/img]

Important changes here include:

1) [b]Separate rosters for each mode.[/b]
For example, "Face Off" roster features combinations that more likely to be interesting and fun for players.
Similarly, "Survival Sim" features fauna in a specific order based on the likely enjoyment of players!
Lifecycles order is unchanged.

2) [b]Random Map / Preset selection is no longer available for Lifecycles.[/b]
This allows the Lifecycles experience to be strictly designed to ensure a more uniform experience.
Note that all Lifecycles maps are still randomly generated; players just can't modify the internal preset anymore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/cf0c4ec0f5f0ea88ad1f4a95ab10c062c57dc253.png[/img]

[h1]Sandbox Quadrant[/h1]
[b]Create & Design - Nature[/b] (formerly Nature Sandbox) & [b]Planetary Ecology[/b] are the game modes under the SANDBOX Quadrant.

"Create & Design - Nature" is envisioned as an overhauled version of the previous Nature Sandbox.

Better User Interface, Tutorials (presented as "Sandbox Quests") & Editing Workflows are the improvements planned in this space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/c24bfa304ec90b2b81db7ec9aeefe6c2f6e5defc.png[/img]

[h1]Fantasy Quadrant[/h1]
[b]"Creature Quests[/b] is the sole game mode currently featured in Fantasy quadrant.

Fantasy Quadrant is envisioned as a collection of experiences that are not intended to be realistic or educational.

This provides a formal leeway for the game to provide players with more traditional gameplay experiences, deriving inspiring from the vast assortment of classic gaming experiences that are already proven to work and well-loved by players.

Story, Adventure, Platforming are the potential elements that this Quadrant could encompass in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/0cf4408444c16b3e62a5a754ed6d70f13b248f9c.png[/img]

[h1]Casual Quadrant[/h1]
[b]Free Exploration[/b] is the sole game mode currently featured in this quadrant.
Zero Hunger & Infinite Stamina allow players to try out different creatures at their own pace.

While DoN's current Free Exploration is a very simple experience, when combined with random map generation (as well as procedural generation of world flora), interesting emergent experiences often unexpectedly arise, so do give this mode a try some time!

In the future Free Exploration will attempt to provide much larger play areas, greater flora and ultimately - biome diversity. Mini-games to encourage exploration and enrich the overall experience are also being considered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/690cdb1be3a1d1fcc43ea68ed33d045f45700da7.png[/img]


[h1]Thank you[/h1]
That's it for this Presentation oriented update!

I hope the new 3D Menu World inspires both new and experienced players to get the most of this game!

Thank you so much for supporting Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar!

With Love,
- Venugopalan Sreedharan
[i](Developer of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/0640818b2275b8dfd7e960ff09748f2314235075.png[/img] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/e98ce2adeb8dcbbfe5ed91a4eda4d0a737e26e57.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Graphics Update for DoN! (Video, Pics within!)
notes.content:
[h1]Relive your favorite experiences![/h1]
[b]A major graphics update has been released for Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar![/b]

Significantly improved visuals for all game modes and species come with this update, so be sure to give it a try!

Aside from graphics, various gameplay improvements have been made as well, read on for complete details!

[h1]Release Video![/h1]
Be sure to watch this short 1 minute video for the improved visuals :)
[previewyoutube=6qAircA-qlU;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]Visual Improvements[/h1]
[h2]Lighting & Colors[/h2]
Overall lighting has been improved to make longer playtimes more comfortable for your eyes. The new lighting is more consistent and should significantly improve player experience across the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/9c3782878e7b2f06f732185ccd0fd70c9e268594.jpg[/img]

[h2]Camera Focus Effect[/h2]
Since much of DoN's gamplay takes place in the foreground and the game's current creatures are so tiny, keeping the player's visual attention focused on the gameplay elements (flora like leaves and flowers) was considered very important. To help with this, background elements are now taken out of focus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/b5c672f14ef4792178bbbe40fae1c98eabc4ba5c.png[/img]

As game's older players will remember, this was already part of the game before, however the effect was somewhat inconsistent and could not cope with the game's complex requirements of modes like Lifecycles. The effect was eventually removed in 2023 for this reason.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/0cae5a89857cf04065c984b211e1752a695a9712.png[/img]

This update however, has finally answered the gargantuan task of configuring the lens effect for every game mode, for every lifecycle and for every creature's instar! After rigorous playtesting. the graphical feature has now been restored again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/eced2d1d192fcd38a555d068c80426daa6c17ee1.png[/img]

[h2]Atmosphere & Fog Effects[/h2]
Draping the entire game world in two layers of fog, this graphical effect brings an additional layer of immersion and realism for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/000f7654d0a7067e3886a41c56cba3e1b641f469.png[/img]
[i]Note: This scene was created using the Nature Sandbox mode[/i]

Currently this effect is somewhat intense and some players may indeed prefer a clearer air for their favorite creatures. However for now this was deemed necessary to minimize the visual influence of the background environment. In the future this will probably be reivsited, depending on how much progress is made on the game's background environment visuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/833a71246cbd4ee9b79ae31f92635b2eb25ff609.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/003131a88b5a8dca8c1d52b1cefe833ef5981eab.png[/img]

[h1]GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[h2]Improved Perspectives[/h2]
Camera perspectives have been improved for nearly all creatures in the game! The new perspectives complement the graphical improvements and should greatly enrich the experience of players across all fauna species.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/15dee2b3d1fb3253a7bd3c977b42dc06b8c19557.png[/img]

[h2]Flight Experience[/h2]
Flight experience has been improved, particularly noticeable for species such as Monarch Butterfly, Dragonfly, Bee and Blue Mud Dauber

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/5cee1c8bf16ec311178a11826e5f26d6a87f0f2d.png[/img]

[h2]Faster Lifecycles! Consumption Rates Increased[/h2]
Completing a lifecycles is now faster than ever before! Consumption speed has been significantly increased across all species, doubled in some cases.

The goal is to help players focus on their gameplay and complete the lifecycles as quickly as possible. With multi-gen lifecycles around the corner (Gen2/Gen3/etc), it was deemed critical to make it as easy as possible for players to complete each Generation and move on to the next.

Note: This update changes only the speed of the consumption visuals - i.e. how fast you eat a given prey. The amount of food provided by a prey remains the same as before! Therefore, this does not affect difficulty level in any way whatsoever, only the speed with which you progress.

[h2]Performance Improvements[/h2]
The Ladybug Lifecycle now has various performance improvements, particularly for the later instars. This should make it easier for players to complete the entire Ladybug lifecycle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/8d69866f53f281028f9bdaaae5726ee5687bd8e3.png[/img]

[h2]Various Bugfixes[/h2]
This update also includes an entire range of bugfixes across the game.

Some of the notable bugfixes include Praying Mantis and  Ladybug Lifecycle quest related bugs, Monarch Lifecycle Racing (Courtship Mini Games)  related bugfixes.

Also improved is AI Flight Landing for Pollinator Insects (like Bees, Butterflies, etc) onto Orange Lily and Knapweed Flowers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/c4509e66f50dc70ed5f88c28212f5bedc10be06d.png[/img]

[h1]Current Plans[/h1]
The game's current focus is on polishing and improving the existing product to ensure that the full potential of all the existing game modes and species is fully realized.

While this update focused on important graphical improvements, the next set of updates will focus entirely on gameplay and overall quality. Before adding any new features or content to the game it is now considered essential that the existing product is properly polished, optimized and uplifted to a point where players can truly enjoy hundreds of hours of solid gameplay from the existing roster.

Once that goal is achieved the game will look towards building on this foundation :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/c3657b692ce4ffde4737068f2455c1fc1ed4bc98.png[/img]

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
Thanks to everyone for your interest in this game!

I sincerely hope that you will enjoy the improved visuals of this update. There is a lot of potential for more great things and the game will keep striving to improve with each day.

I want this game to reach a point where it is the most fun and most enjoyable game to play in their game library for all players who come by this way.

With your support, enthusiasm and feedback, this goal will be realized one day!

Thank you!

 With Love,
Venugopalan Sreedharan
[i](Developer of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/e98ce2adeb8dcbbfe5ed91a4eda4d0a737e26e57.png[/img]

Draping the entire game world in two layers of fog, this graphical effect brings an additional layer of immersion and realism for the game.

notes.title: The Praying Mantis Lifecycle Patch #3 is here! ~~ Significant Improvements!! ~~
notes.content:
[hr][/hr] 
Dear Wonderful Players of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar!

[b]Patch #3 for the Praying Mantis Lifecycles is out![/b]

Bringing [b]Gender selection[/b], [b]Locomotion improvements[/b] & lots more, this update is a must-play for every fan of [b]DoN[/b]!

[hr][/hr] 
[h1]What's New[/h1]

[h2]Mantis Male / Female Gender Selection[/h2]
Players can now choose Gender for the Mantis at the outset.

Similar to other species in the game, the Female's gameplay includes Oviposition, while the male is allowed to proceed directly to Gen 2 after Mating (via the "Skip To End Of Life" option in the Main Menu).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/b7be6f0630f05149283a79b00f619eb6ea1b57f1.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr] 

[h2]Mantis Locomotion Vastly Improved[/h2]
Moving around is now much easier!

Large Mantis Instars will now find crossing across leaves easier than before. Getting stuck in mid-air has also been resolved, yielding a far more smoother and reliable overall experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/52e18b04922070d1ec863e124f76c1bb04ea25ef.gif[/img]

These improvements also carry over to the game's other major spectacles, such as the Jumping Spider and Ladybug Lifecycles too!

Do try playing DoN's other spectacles once again if it's been a while since you've played them! :)

[hr][/hr] 

[h2]Beauty of Vision[/h2]
Smoother camera for the Praying Mantis Lifecycle makes it possible for players to experience the "Mantis Tree World" with far greater immersion than ever before.

Additionally, zooming for the adult Mantis has also been fixed, enabling players to take in unique vistas and perspectives by zooming out more easily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/c2634553be998eb6f7d6bb42c93db470ac3b1f7d.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr] 

[h2]Praying Mantis Lifecycles - Generation 2[/h2]
Gen 2 has been fixed. This was recently broken with a bug that prevented Moulting in Gen 2. Now players can continue from Gen 1 into Gen 2 without issues :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/82cbf2eee04d621e708324360a2ae5b2cc2e7c08.png[/img]

[hr][/hr] 


[h2]Lifecycles Presentation[/h2]
Quest icons have now been added for each [b]Life Goal[/b] making it easier for players to relate to pending quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/1c2cdd57412013cf92dfac74ceb4c47896471454.jpg[/img]

Along with new animations for the Life Goals HUD, quest summary has been improved for several quests.

Finally, various minor improvements have also been included, such as better workflow for the Benchmark and Feedback tools.

[hr][/hr] 

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
Thanks a lot for your interest in this game! :)

[b]All in all, this update is essential for all those who enjoy this game! Be sure to pick it up and try out your favorite game modes / creatures![/b]

~ That's it for this update, but there's always more to come! :)

With Love,
Venugopalan Sreedharan
[i](Developer of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar)[/i]

notes.title: Praying Mantis Lifecycle Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/97d2999f94b2141725a1cf94def6ddf9ad43b903.jpg[/img]

[h1]Experience The Mantis Tree World![/h1]
The Praying Mantis Lifecycle has now been released on the grandest stage this game has ever seen:

[b]A Living Tree World[/b] -  procedurally generated with every leaf, every flower and every shoot depicted as complete 3D surfaces! A Tree World so detailed so real that players can walk, climb, rest or hunt upon any part of it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/ee623c4ad96e76d8d2d220c9918310161f6539c6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/385a7015e4a3e1d893590398e6fb9b05a842e375.jpg[/img]

Thousands upon thousands of leaves, stalks and flowers surround you, each of them with teeming with so much insect life, that the player can conceivably never run out of prey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/291093af878f53faf60ae752ce2bd96d65b3dd0c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/67cf00e8fefe5ac9b91262f479d3f2c911b3d6b9.jpg[/img]

Indeed, dear friends! This Tree World is so huge, compared to you as the player that no Mantis can conceivably ever explore all of it!

 Also because the Tree is procedurally generated anew each game, each "Mantis Tree World" is slightly different from your previous experience :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/bfade2c5c9ad8a5644db8ff1bcd5d0bac6e99bdb.jpg[/img]

[h1]~ The Praying Mantis Lifecycle - Visual Overview ~[/h1]

Here's a quick visual overview of your Mantis' Six instars, from Egg to Winged Adult!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/a3ccf03cd1b9aea5a27a76dfddd778b5eb7592f9.jpg[/img]

[h1]~ Current State & Known Issues  ~[/h1]
Camera, performance and animations are 3 areas that need improvements, upcoming updates will address as many of these as are possible now.

"Living Tree World" is the key concept behind this update with the Praying Mantis Lifecycle occurring within that context. Ultimately several compromises had to be made to the original vision due to limited resources, but upcoming updates will keep adding to this vision across the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/77d41921b2f0f12633aa74eceda21a450446a25c.jpg[/img]

Players who are having any particular issues with this update - particularly Camera, Movement or Performance are requested to check back for subsequent updates, which will hopefully happen soon. ~ 

[h1] Thank you! [/h1]
First of all heartfelt gratitude to all the supporters of this game and for your support through all these years.

For those wondering about why there were no updates for so long, it has not been possible to sustain the game's development due to low sales in the past several years. Hopefully this will change in the days to come and it will then be possible to make more frequent updates :)

Thanks to everyone for your interest in this game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/584dd5c3df2b7d20bf7d2f04e87263af2750e697.jpg[/img]

I hope you enjoy playing the Praying Mantis Lifecycles update!

With Love,
- Venugopalan Sreedharan

notes.title: v0.5.2 Released for Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar!
notes.content:
Happy Weekend, Dear Friends!

DoN's Version v0.5.2 is out!

Featuring more improvements across the board, this build focuses on polishing existing gameplay systems and visual content. Here's a quick round up!

[h1]Visual Improvements[/h1]
[h3]Depth Of Field Disabled across the board[/h3]
For improving consistency of visuals as well as performance, DoF has been entirely removed from the game as an interim measure. This was a stylistic choice as well as to provide consistency across small/large instars and the game's camera zooming feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/664881a743fe625d412b985649c1952a91df3d8c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/2e4e1514681888df4b5087dec75e7c39e810e8b1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/84752e97011ff1effdf0dac39968f9d957616fa0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Leafhopper post-life coloration improved[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/8a2649756a362ddd0c0ce2317640ed9eea084c3d.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Grasshopper's Mighty Legs![/h1]
This is a multi-update effort aimed at improving the visual quality of the [b]Grasshopper's Leg Kicks[/b] - a defensive feature that many of us Grasshopper players have come to truly love, but has been greatly let down in the past by incomplete visual depiction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/bb0bdd9f921f125eebc21ebea6eb7f509f2185e4.gif[/img]

This update begins the task of polishing this feature by fixing the following:
[list]
[*] Predators are no longer buried half-way through a leaf after being kicked - their body lines up neatly along the flora surface
[*] Player camera no longer abruptly changes view or forces you upside down - it is always stable and consistent
[*] Consistent behavior across different surfaces (leaf v/s landscape, upright v/s upside down pose, etc)
[/list]

More to come as always!

[h1]Audio Improvements[/h1]
[h3]Game Music Maximum Volume significanlty increased![/h3]
Given much positive feedback from players in the recent year on the game's OST, the decision was made to [b]uncap the maximum possible volume[/b] of all in-game music (Settings -> Audio -> Music) enabling those players who really like the music, to have an absolute blast!

The plan to release all the game's OST as a download for players to easily listen outside the game is still active and will occur soon. Along with remastering of old sound tracks, new music will also be added - DoN's fount of music is still gushing forth!

Note: The default music volume for the game has also been increased, in the belief that the game's music is vital to its enjoyment.

As always, your feedback is welcome :)

[h1] Up Next - Praying Mantis Lifecycle[/h1]
Work has already begun on the game's next major update - The Praying Mantis Lifecycle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/8515d6f26f8affa1b456220655983f7272d749dc.jpg[/img]

These weekly improvement & bugfix updates will continue to roll in every Friday, but major updates are also being worked on simultaneously.

You can look forward to [b]early screenshots of the Mantis Egg Sac[/b] (Oothecea) soon! :)

Thank you so much for reading and [b]have a blast this weekend![/b] :) :)

[h3]With Love,[/h3]
[h3]Venugopalan Sreedharan[/h3]
[i]Developer of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar[/i]

notes.title: Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar's v0.5.1 update released!
notes.content:
DoN is being improved around the clock and this weekend release delivers all the goodies that went in over the past 2 weeks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/fa7057822649bbdcbf54fcebea56b2cb7d6de970.jpg[/img]

[h1]V0.5.1 Release Roundup[/h1]

[h2]Input Keys highlighting[/h2]

All player input hints have now been improved - raw text has been replaced with appropriate buttons and icons which are appropriately highlighted. This should make it much easier for new players to learn the game's controls!

Additionally, a new high-contrast theme is used for all player hints to make things easier to read.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/b321e336ad9277b2241cc7e0806564d41b7c4c10.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/41de5773d3437b7cdf42b4c3497d07bad39d1e0a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/28c5f3eff19c24c0b181648afbdf15e3a94eeeb1.jpg[/img]

[h2]DoN's Minimal HUD[/h2]
This is a multi-update effort which aims at delivering maximum immersion to players by minimizing the need for the HUD to the greatest extent possible.

Here's what this this update has changed:
	• HUD is hidden when player arrives within strike range of prey (if player has passed all relevant tutorials)
	• HUD is hidden while player interacts with prey.
	• HUD is automatically shown again during critical events such as grappling contests, etc

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/6099be0e9e2d74df9b40a36f1ace98d1eaf1dc06.jpg[/img]
[i]An actual in-game screenshot - The HUD is automatically hidden during key moments for maximum immersion![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/4e12ee9afa9a3819d09c0ab7db236c3ce49380cd.jpg[/img]

Subsequent updates will bring further improvements under this umbrella, so look forward to a more immersive overall experience of the game! :)

[h2]Improvements & Bugfixes[/h2]
[h3] Lifecycles[/h3]
[b]Jumping Spider[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Sprinting speed significantly increased[/b] for Jumping Spider - It is now so much more fun! 
[*] [b]Sprinting cost reduced[/b] for all Fauna. You are encouraged to sprint and run around more! :)
[*] Sprint tutorial (in egg sac) now transitions out smoothly to the next quest
[*] Narration Avatar for Mother Jumping Spider restored in Egg Sac (see below!)
[/list]
[h3] Nature Sandbox[/h3]
[list]
[*] Possessing Nocturnal Wasp during Day no longer causes freezing
[/list]

That's it for this update, but you can look forward to a [b]new release every weekend[/b] for DoN from now on!

The game is now being improved around the clock allowing this shift to a [b]weekly[/b] release cycle.

The next update will be out on [b][u]26th May 2023[/u][/b] and is sure to bring more improvements across the board to DoN's unique Nature World!

Thanks a lot for reading :)

[h3]With Love,[/h3]
[h2]Venugopalan Sreedharan[/h2]
[i]Developer of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar[/i]

notes.title: Drunk On Nectar v0.5 Released! Full Development Resumes for 2023
notes.content:
Drunk On Nectar is back into full development again!

This [b]milestone v0.5 update[/b] is literally the halfway point for the game towards a [b]Full Release out of Early Access[/b]. The game's development process has been revitalized on many levels and is now fully equipped to realize this goal for 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/7acb8d18367a9fd9e6007f5443a594880298af21.jpg[/img]

v0.5 features the game's largest collection of [b]Visual and Gameplay[/b] improvements, bugfixes, menu and narration updates and is a [b]must play experience for both old and new players[/b]  of the game.

You can now expect a new update [b]every 2 weeks[/b] from here on. so this is just the beginning of something great!

[h1]What's Changed in v0.5[/h1]

Here's a quick roundup:

[h2]Chemical Vision Perfected: [/h2]Across tiny instars and large adults, across flora, fauna and various game modes, time of the day, unique gameplay situations like highly populated swarms, etc, etc, DoN's Chemical Trails have been [b]reimagined and corrected[/b] for visual and gameplay perfection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/ae1552cf7bf252cae31ef46b9b848a9b141ddb80.jpg[/img]

[b]Chemical trails no longer stay permanently on the screen.[/b]

The most important gameplay change here is that [b]players now have to Hold X[/b] to perceive chemical trails. The goal here was to reduce visual overload, encourage more intelligent planning and to open up new gameplay avenues. 

[h3]Swarm AI - Significantly Improved[/h3]
The behaviour of AI swarms has undergone major changes. They're now far more placid, predictable and play out perfectly well for complex predator interactions.

Your experience of the Jumping Spider Lifecycle and Ladybug Lifecycle in particular should be massively improved - more fun, rewarding and interesting as a consequence!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/e104ec8719e49a4677f55174a5b0e9073f5da1c8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Chemical Filters - Redefining your view of the world![/h2]
The game now offers a full range of chemical filters which can be cycled by [b]Tapping the C key[/b].

[h3]Chem Filter: Prey Only[/h3]
This mode limits your chemical vision to only prey that you can currently catch and eat. For example, if a Grasshopper is too large for your current instar then it is entirely skipped! This allows you as a predator to focus your energy intelligently on prey that you can actually catch when you get there :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/00cb6669e6afa06ee7331bcf3f0177b2e338a2ec.jpg[/img]

[h3]Chem Filter: Predators Only[/h3]
Ever nervous about whether a Jumping Spider or Dragonfly was prowling about you? Well, put your fears to rest by turning on the "Predators Only" chemical filter, which limits your chemical view of the world to only those predators which might actually be interested (and able - i.e. by weight, species. etc) to catch you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/27559ccfde02dbb3ec87129158d7499ee1bffa03.jpg[/img]

[h3]Chem Filter: Mates Only[/h3]
A classic for Lifecycles Act 3 - Mating & Reproduction. This filter limits your vision to only those fauna that you can actually flirt or mate with. Forget about those prey and predators and fly away to find a beautiful mate! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/46faf7d76a1a21b5c18ef0c01540083538f249b4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Chem Filter: Flora Only[/h3]
A treat for advanced predator players - You can now smell floral nectar trails - even as a predator and thus predict which flowers are more likely to actually be visited by butterflies and bees :) No more wasting time sitting on the wrong flower!

Perfect for a Praying Mantis laying ambush!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/3390f4f95ae67ef824ae642a8c569bd3a9954b8d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Chem Filter: All Fauna[/h3]
This is pretty much game's previous chemical trail mode which would show you all of everything. It can get very visually intense, but they will now fade away the moment the player releases the Chem Vision key (Default: X), thus preventing visual overload.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/400fbbcb2df44f4ff4b9cf31f05ed753f864f503.jpg[/img]

[h2]Other Improvements by category[/h2]
Chem vision and AI swarms weren't the only thing improved, this update brings a ton of bugfixes and many long awaited changes across the board.

[h3]Visuals & Graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Landscape texturing at close range improved. Most obvious for tiny instars of Jumping Spiders, Ladybug larva, etc while they're off prowling across the forest floor :)
[*] Landscape texture shaking at close range greatly minimized. Future updates will fully fix this by bringing in new landscapes altogether!
[*] Camera behaviour for drinking nectar from flowers vastly improved. Abrupt jerking fully eliminated, viewing angles are always smooth now!
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay (Common)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bodyfat saturation cooldown - Allows caterpillars plenty of time to rest / scout before pupation, instead of being forced to eat again and make up for lost bodyfat!
[*] Tiny Predators are now protected from large grasshopper chew holes during tutorial quests.
[*] Camera behaviour for drinking nectar from flowers vastly improved. Abrupt jerking fully eliminated, viewing angles are always smooth now!
[/list]

[h3]Lifecycles[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jumping Spider
[list]
[*] Dragonfly quest no longer freezes during narration
[*] Silk Tent Construction vastly simplified - the first two phases (spinning silk) have been removed. Now build your tent in just under 30 seconds!!!
[*] Chemical trails are now carefully designed (size & intensity) across all instars
[*] AI Mates now start off with full satiety (hunger, bodyfat). This ensures they don't run off to look for food while the player engages them for courtship and mating!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/1b3ec10cf615f702106112e5cc2bcc8157290f3d.jpg[/img]
[i]Silk Tent Construction vastly simplified![/i]

[*] Monarch Butterfly Lifecycle
[list]
[*] Mating Rituals: Chem trails are now carefully controlled at each stage
[/list]

[*] Ladybug Lifecycle
[list]
[*] Chem trails are far more manageable now, yielding vastly improved gameplay
[*] Swarm AI behaviour vastly improved
[/list]

[*] Grasshopper Lifecycle
[list]
[*] Critical bugfix to grass blades: Chew holes no longer "disappear" on certain grass blades.
[*] New "Predators Only" chem filter of special interest for Grasshopper Lifecycle players!
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Survival Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Praying Mantis Survival
[list]
[*] Various bugfixes to animation state and locomotion
[*] "Prey Only" chem filter ensures that oversized Grasshoppers are not shown as potential targets!
[/list]

[*] Blue Mud Dauber Survival
[list]
[*] Gameplay completely rebalanced, much easier to complete now.
[*] Sensory range vastly increased to make it easier to hunt spiders
[*] Nectar consumption and hunger rates increased and decreased, respectively.
[*] Critical bugfixes to resolve blockers that prevent progress at various points
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Creature Quests[/h3]
[list]
[*] Checkpoint system fixed. This was previously broken in many cases
[*] Ladybug Creature Quest made a lot more fun and easy thanks to the Chemical Vision improvements
[/list]

[h3]Nature Sandbox[/h3]
[list]
[*] Squirrel removed from fauna menu as it is not yet complete
[*] Various other bugfixes
[*] Major improvements are planned to Nature Sandbox in upcoming updates!
[/list]

[h1]Major Upcoming Updates[/h1]

Several groundbreaking updates are headed your way, notably

[h3]Skill Trees - Lifecycles Act 4 - A Tale of Generations[/h3]
Ever wished your creature was a lot bigger, or could move faster, or jump higher?

Well, Lifecycles Act 4 will make this possible!

Level up across multiple generations. choose new skills and create your own unique expressions of the game existing species. Featuring RPG elements such as a Specices Tech Tree, this update will add unparalleled depth to the game's existing offerings and is guaranteed to provide endless replay value for the game's ardent fans.

[h3]Subspecies - Variations of existing fauna - Butterflies, Jumping Spiders, Grasshoppers etc [/h3]
This content focused update will add new subspecies of existing creatures.

So more butterflies, more types of Jumping Spiders, more Grasshoppers - some bigger, some smaller, some green, some brown, etc.

New models, animations and textures will infuse new vigor and life into the game's existing offerings.

[h3]Living Flora - Plant & Environment Focus[/h3]
One of the oldest pillars of Drunk On Nectar is its extensive "Living Flora" plant simulation engine. Historically this has not been featured as much in the game, but the goal of this update is to absolutely revitalize the plants, the flora, the environment - i.e. the natural foundation which the rest of the game and all its creatures depend on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/e9bdab227802912b1d8a503a23762b60d873bb07.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank You[/h1]
My heartfelt thanks to the game's loving players for your belief in this game and for your patience through the past years.

I'm deeply grateful for your patronage and am absolutely thrilled to walk this road of successful release of the game, here with all of you.

The past few years have been exceedingly challenging, but now the time has come at long last for the game to shine in its full splendor. I am fully committed to achieving this and will do absolutely everything in my power and indeed - beyond that, to fully ensure that Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar is complete, successful and brings a lot of fun, happiness and joy to all who may play it!

With lots of love to the game's wonderful players and fans, 
Venugopalan Sreedharan
[i](Developer of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar)[/i]

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

PS: If you could report any bugs or other issues you run into with this update either here or on the forums, that would be very greatly appreciated! :)

notes.title: New Development Begins for Drunk On Nectar's Steam Release!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

Today marks the beginning of a new development cycle for [b]Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar[/b]!

The goal is to complete the first version of DoN, get [b]V1[/b] out of Early Access and into a full release, over the next 4-6 months or so.

Learn more about the plans below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/a4f9969200a61ff7c6ed249b2e0aad620f938827.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Plan[/h1]
In terms of next updates - Subspecies, new environments and supporting content that uses existing game systems will be the main priority.

Polishing the product towards completion of "V1" will be the overall goal.

This will include things like:
[olist]
[*] More species of Butterflies, Spiders, Bees, Beetles, etc.
[*] More Plants, Trees, environmental attractions (water bodies, etc)
[*] New maps that will form the primary game experience 
    (existing Random maps will be purely optional)
[*] Nature Sandbox Content
        i) Tutorials
        ii) Quests / more things to do
[*] Fixing bugs and glitches
[*] Improving animations & physics
[/olist]


[h1]Music Of DoN - Album release celebrating the return![/h1]
Over the past months several players have written to me saying they really enjoyed the game's music and would like to have access to all the audio tracks outside the game.

Celebrating the game's return to development and honoring this request, the game's full BGM set (and there's lot more yet to come!) will indeed be released within a week or so for players to enjoy outside of the game. What's more many of these tracks will be resampled as well as remastered to showcase the game's music in the best possible light!

[h1]Thank You![/h1]
That's it for now, but stay tuned for more news on the next update!

[i]Spring enters the world of DoN again!
Green shoots abound amid golden rain.
Rainbow flowers peep out of glistening glades
Jumping insects frolic, dancing with mates!
The morning sun shines on golden drops of dew
Drunk On Nectar shall blossom and be born anew!
[/i]

It will be fun to soar through the glades again!

My sincere thanks to the game's most wonderful players!

With Love
- Venu

notes.title: Praying Mantis Survival Major Improvements - Easier & more fun!
notes.content:
The next series of updates for "Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar" is underway!

Today's update brings a vastly improved experience for the Praying Mantis Survival release.

The Mantis is now easier to play, control and survive with, so please do give the Mantis Survival another playthrough now :)

A full video series will be uploaded soon, but below is a summary of what this update brings.

[h1]Mantis Flying & Hunting made much easier[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mantis now emits far less vibrations, visibility to prey. This makes it easy for players to quickly fly from plant to plant and prepare to ambush prey upon landing.
[*] Flight speed increased - Mantis' minimum and maximum flight speed both have been significantly increased
[*] Flight acceleration doubled - Mantis can acquire its maximum flight speed more swiftly now!
[*] Flight stamina increased - for easier flying and more fun in the air!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/b361b76b65fbae11c00160d7aa69d920942b8b18.jpg[/img]
  
[h1]Ambush System - Significant Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ambush pose now confers significant strike range bonus! In addition to camouflage this now provides players with a great incentive for using ambush instead of direct attacks.
[*] Direct attacks (single left click) are now permitted for Mantis while at close proximity to prey. Players are no longer forced to use the ambush mechanic every time!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/1c60d6e7ec580778b41db46dd867e88a3c4368dc.jpg[/img]
	
[h1]"Chem grit" system improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Chemical odors (accrued from consumption) are now greatly reduced.
[*] Players are now provided with an explicit alert when a prey smells you, informing you that body odour levels are significantly high and that Grooming is needed :)
[/list]
	
[h1]New Chem Filters - "Prey Only"[/h1]
[list]
[*] Pressing the C key now allows players to filter out chemical visions to "prey only" for predators or between Fauna and Flora for others.
[*] The game now explicitly informs players of the active chemical filter through the HUD.
[*] New chem filters such as "Predator Only" are also arriving in upcoming updates :)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/c0989019ffb66f46578c4c326f1f062a8146b866.jpg[/img]
 
[h1] Upcoming Updates[/h1]
 Several updates have been planned for the game, below is a quick roadmap:
 
[b] 1) Unlockable difficulty modes for Praying Mantis Survival[/b]
 Players will be be able to unlock "Medium" and "Hard" difficulty modes once they finish the Survival challenge once. While the current update is designed to be friendly to new players, the higher modes will satisfy experienced players far more and will require players to fully master various gameplay mechanics and thus provide maximum challenge and fun! :)

[b]2) In-Game Video Library update[/b]
A comprehensive in-game video library is planned that will allow player to easily look at reference videos for every single quest, mechanic or tutorial in the game. This will help players who may be stuck at a certain quest or are simply curious to learn the fastest or most efficient ways to complete a quest or lifecycle :)
 
[b]3) Praying Mantis Lifecycles update[/b]
 As the second installation of the game's Praying Mantis release Lifecycles for the Mantis is still planned and a top priority for the game at this time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/116cb44f6afa034e16695962c71d1fd482104fa1.jpg[/img]

[b]4) Subspecies - roster expansion update[/b]
New varieties of Butterflies, Jumping Spiders, Praying Mantis, Grasshoppers, etc will be added to the game introducing a "subspecies" concept that will add immense interest, depth and variety to the existing creatures and their individual survival or lifecycle modes.

Subspecies is not a purely visual or cosmetic update - major gameplay changes including body size, life behavior and other unique subspecies characteristics will provide a completely new experience of each existing major species :) This will be accompanied by a complete overhaul of the game menu, species selection screen as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/af7aef55d66263131d464776166c28bb56d7eed5.jpg[/img]
[h1] 
 Thank You![/h1]
 That's it for this update, but stay tuned for more news as there's a lot of fun planned this summer for fans of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar! :)
 
 Thank you for your interest, patronage and love as always! :)
 
 With heartfelt Thanks, Gratitude and Love,
[b] - Venugopalan Sreedharan[/b]
[i](Developer Of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/a4f9969200a61ff7c6ed249b2e0aad620f938827.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Praying Mantis Survival Released!
notes.content:
Featuring the Praying Mantis, enjoy the best Survival experience ever presented in Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar, to date!

Survive 7 days of Spring as an adult Mantis amid intense competition from prey and predator rivals, all set in a new "Mantis Survival" map preset producing a lush, beautiful and ever changing world.

Exciting new gameplay features have also been added along with the largest set of bugfixes and improvements added to the entire game this year.

[b]Do not miss this update![/b]

[h3]Release Video[/h3]
https://youtu.be/zKWaEAfJJaM

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/72aa3824bc3eae12a68efedf7efaf411ef98e689.jpg[/img]

[h3]"Mantis Survival" - A New Random Map Preset[/h3]
Demonstrating the full power of the random map generator, "Mantis Survival" is a completely new map preset that looks, feels and plays quite differently from the existing maps.

Featuring the largest map size (play area) yet, this preset produces broad and expansive meadows with plenty of space for your Mantis to fly, explore and have fun!

The highest fauna population of prey and predators across all the map presets is also found here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/c0989019ffb66f46578c4c326f1f062a8146b866.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Gameplay Features[/h3]
[b]Ambush[/b] is a new predator skill added just for the Mantis!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/1f40f2c53ab67c355545039f2d8b28625c69fdf0.jpg[/img]

[b]Chemical grit[/b] accrual is another new feature whereby prey can smell chemical trails from your previous meal. So hunting becomes gradually harder unless you Groom yourself and clear the chemical debris regularly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/3e9bf1c6fd090f35a36588c4a74aa51efcd35ceb.jpg[/img]

[b]Flight Stamina[/b] is a new concept whereby the Mantis can recharge its flight ability while walking. For those players that dislike stopping completely for a Stamina recharge, this provides non-stop, seamless motion. Fly for a while, continue walking while your flight ability recharges and fly on again! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/b361b76b65fbae11c00160d7aa69d920942b8b18.jpg[/img]

[h3]Comprehensive in-game tutorial for Mantis Survival[/h3]
Covering the basics, advanced skills and also new gameplay features (see above!), this Praying Mantis update features the most comprehensive in-game tutorial in the game yet.

New players are provided the opportunity to gain complete confidence in controlling the Mantis being plunged into the 7 day survival challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/d92c3d003c77b9e91ffc63dde13c9b0f6bb493c6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Large number of Improvements, Bugfixes[/h3]
This update also includes a large collection of bugfixes and improvements that were made over the past several months.

From reworked Lighting to improved locomotion, AI behavior, fixes for player crashing reports to memory and performance improvements, this update brings the game much closer to a stable version for full release.

An imporant bugfix benefiting all flying creatures in the game is [b]Smooth Flight[/b] - flight controls no longer jutter / spin around in relation to FPS fluctuations; this provides a significantly better flying experience for players!

Another crucial bugfix relates to video memory optimization, this fixes a large number of related player issues, including freezing, crashes and low performance, all particularly related to long playthroughs.

[h3]Praying Mantis - Lifecycles[/h3]
Lifecycle of the Praying Mantis will indeed be the next update.

While vast majority of the work is already complete, certain unique aspects of the Mantis lifecycle (like the Mantis egg case), early instar gameplay and gender dimorphism depiction, need to be completed.

In the meantime I hope that you enjoy this Survival take on the Praying Mantis :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/116cb44f6afa034e16695962c71d1fd482104fa1.jpg[/img]
[i]Praying Mantis Lifecycles - Also Coming Soon![/i]

[h3]Thank you[/h3]
As always, thank you so much for your interest, patience, love and support!

Nature is forever beautiful, awesome and fun!

With Love,
Venugopalan Sreedharan
(Developer of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar)

notes.title: Praying Mantis Lifecycle - The Next Update!
notes.content:
Dear players,

The much awaited Praying Mantis Lifecycle is game's next update and it is almost there!

Players will experience the complete lifecycle of the Praying Mantis across multiple generations with new gameplay mechanics and strategies completely unique to the Mantis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/d554598a14815b1c753c1c1e11976b70177fc816.jpg[/img]
[i]Preview image - A first Instar Praying Mantis espies a massive world awaiting exploration![/i]

[h1]Today's update[/h1]
An update was released for DoN today that the sets the stage for the Mantis release by bringing vast improvements to the overall game.

Below is a gist of what [b]today's update[/b] includes:

[h1]Checkpoints added to all Creature Quests for easy completion![/h1]
Unlike the Lifecycle mode which puts emphasis on species depiction, the Creature Quests mode offers a more traditional gameplay experience and currently features two unique challenge maps for the Jumping Spider and Ladybug respectively.

In response to player feedback that the Creature Quests were too difficult or prolonged, this update adds a new Checkpoint system.

Players who fail to complete a challenge map (by falling in water, etc!) can immediately resume at the latest checkpoint and try again! The leaderboard timer counts the duration of all your attempts together of course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/4f24543a180f11a7fa97be8887d4bd689818a690.jpg[/img]
[i]Checkpoint system in action for the "A Curious Triad" Ladybug Creature Quest![/i]

Creature Quests, in my personal experience as the developer of this game, offers some of the most unique and enjoyable experiences the game has to offer. If you have previously tried this mode but were put off by the difficulty level or perhaps found it tedious to repeat an entire challenge map for just a single fall, do try Creature Quests again as this update enables players to freely explore the challenge maps for any desired duration.

Falls are now not punished with a restart, but with a safe return to the latest checkpoint from where you can experiment freely again! :)

Notable mention for the Ladybug challenge map which contains several checkpoints hidden away in unique locations (can you find them all!?), along with a "Giant Mantis" prop honoring the imminent Praying Mantis release :))

[h1]Tree shadows for high-end PCs![/h1]
Until now trees in the game did not cast any shadows at all due to size constraints (each tree is absolutely massive relative to a tiny insect!).

With this update however, high-end PCs will enjoy full tree shadowing to take DoN's nature scenes to a new level of visual richness!

Just make sure the Shadow quality slider in "Video Settings" is set to the maximum as that is what selectively enables and disables tree shadowing in the current version.

Trees are expected to become more and more important as gameplay elements for DoN, so eventually trees with active gameplay will indeed have shadowing enabled for lower end PCs as well.

Below is a visual comparison:

[i]Without Tree Shadows[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/4f492376f88de7ecdb1d7d8def636ba836a25c61.jpg[/img]

[i]With Tree Shadows[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/f49ad44ed030c0c50cb7affa89804ea460d0481e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Praying Mantis Lifecycle Release ETA[/h1]
Currently body visuals and gameplay prototyping for the Mantis is still underway, but with DoN's powerful lifecycle frameworks ready at hand, the overall flow is already nearing completion.

Approximately 2 weeks, i.e. late September or early October, is the expected timeframe based on the current trajectory :)

Thanks to everyone for your great patience in waiting for the Mantis update since the original announcement.

I greatly look forward to playing as the Praying Mantis along with all of you, hopefully very soon :)

With Love,
Venugopalan Sreedharan
[i](Developer of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar)[/i]

notes.title: Beautiful Nature - New Lighting, Gen 2 for Jumping Spider Lifecycle Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/bcd8e42ee3d411ade5c03a8a1dfc68d971ccf27c.jpg[/img]

Bringing improved lighting and graphics across the board and deep polishing of the entire Jumping Spider lifecycle, this is a major update to the game that also carries vital bugfixes and a fully working [b]Generation 2 gameplay[/b] for the Jumping Spider lifecycle!

[h1]Beautiful Nature[/h1]
DoN's basic lighting has been reworked to provide a more realistic appearance. The new lighting depicts floral and anatomical detail in the world much better and reacts better to varying lighting scenarios across time of day and environment.

World items like the Jumping Spider's Silken egg sac have undergone major graphical changes too. Brightness, flickering and shadowing issues in the egg sac have been fixed and it no longer "glows in the dark" at night now.

Overall visual experience should be significantly improved within the egg sac, allowing players to better focus on gameplay within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/b8d1e603276c197328d4d1615521a740a6d50934.jpg[/img]

Finally, the Jumping Spider itself has been visually improved! Earlier instars now better show translucency through their bodies while the adult female Jumping Spider's skin lighting also been improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/f2d2bc9cf134bfdbdbed984b37df8148a595f387.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/dddf93ae6f2118236c115ccc68bf13990b46779d.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Best of Jumping Spider Lifecycle![/h1]
Emphasizing the best parts of the Jumping Spider lifecycle and removing aspects that players frequently had issues with, this latest version of the Jumping Spider lifecycle is a far crisper and smoother experience across its nine instars.

With Generation 2 now fully working (see below!) the focus is on enabling players to quickly and happily complete Gen 1's quests so they are sure to experience Gen 2's unique and emergent gameplay as well.

Complex lifecycle quests like the "Pollinator Hunt" have therefore been greatly simplified, while frequent predator intervention (prominent among player feedback) has been greatly reduced.

Silk tent construction is faster by nearly twice now to help players proceed more swiftly as well! 

Major improvements to camera and visual effects have been made as well, all with the goal of providing a super fast paced and fluent experience that can do justice to the Jumping Spider's incredible range of movement and abilities.

[b]Experienced players of the game are highly encouraged to give this lifecycle another playthrough![/b] :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/e4e237549d65a162522e17b5ab052bd87b2c0159.jpg[/img]

[h1]Predator Evasion System[/h1]
Inspired by the Grasshopper's evasion cues but now combined with the Jumping Spider's skills, this update brings a formal "Predator Evasion System".

Quickly Dart or Long Jump within an evasion time window to successfully prevent all further attacks from that predator for a while!

Players having issues with predators will hopefully find it much easier now as you can finally use the Jumping Spider's incredible physical agility to evade predators with a very satisfying dart or leap :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/ac8ebeff71ee434513f808de3786d83edb8f29aa.jpg[/img]

[h1]Generation 2 fully playable for Jumping Spider.
Can you reach Generation 3?[/h1]

Generation 2 for the Jumping Spider has been thoroughly tested and improved for maximum fun!

[b]Performance optimization[/b] has been extensively conducted for Gen 2 and should now yield a significantly smoother experience for players! :)

Currently providing some of the best emergent gameplay in the entire game, Gen 2 is a very unique experience that all Jumping Spider afficionados should be sure to complete all the way.

With no quests or formal direction provided to the player, you are free to Balloon through the land, forging your own growth story and making your own adventures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/ebc675e061ac485684f955bae3fb414298285c89.jpg[/img]

Generation 3 is now reachable at last, though gameplay balancing and performance optimization for Gen 3 hasn't been conducted yet, so Gen 3 is left to the brave and mightly for now :))

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/2b7b05a91e3f317edaae6b5c75946de2b65ab1f1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Looking ahead[/h1]

The game's upcoming priorities are being worked out and the next set of updates should be out pretty soon!

Hope you are enjoying this series of 2021 updates for Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar!

With Love,
- Venu
[i](Developer of DoN)[/i]

notes.title: Jumping Spider's Long Jumps redesigned, More bugfixes & improvements
notes.content:
The next round of improvements to DoN is here!

Along with major bugfixes and improvements this update also features redesigned gameplay.

Notably...

[h1]Long Jumps Redesigned[/h1]
In response to feedback from players over the years, Long Jumping for the Jumping Spider has been great simplified with a new "aim and leap" design that is more intuitive and reduces the number of input buttons you need to remember!

Now just use the mouse to point to where you'd like to jump... and that's it :)

Visual improvements have also been added here! Now the jump reticule accurately orients itself to the surface you're jumping onto (like the underside of a flower or steep side of a stalk) providing valuable visual information before you make that pivotal jump!

Another visual improvement is easier aiming for jumps that end in midair - the jump reticle now anchors itself onto the midair point you're leaping onto (rather than the surface you'll fall onto) making it easier to adjust and perform corrections during complex jumps.

So, Happy Jumping, everyone! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/954da24ce88a66b596a47655b442fa4350276a3c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Camera Improvements[/h1]
Includes:
   [list]
[*]   Better transitions during movement, darts and jumps
[*]      Moving fast across dense clumps of flora now yields a better camera experience.
[/list]

[h1]Critical bugfixes[/h1]
 * [b]Monarch Mating[/b] flying issues prior to female race fixed
 * [b]Planteray Ecology[/b] - No longer crashes during "Submerge land masses" tutorial

Apologies to new players in the recent week whose experience of the game may have been dampened or cut short but the above issues. There's a lot more to experience now that these issues have been fixed so please give the game a try again now :)

[h1]Looking ahead[/h1]
The ongoing focus continues to be on general improvements and bugfixes, gradually building momentum towards larger updates.

Appreciate your patience and support during this transition period as the game's development gradually pushes forward into full throttle again :)

Thank you everyone :)

- Venugopalan Sreedharan
[i](Developer of Nature & Life - Drunk On Nectar)[/i]

notes.content:
Bringing improvements to the entire game across both gameplay and visuals, here is a quick overview of this release.

[h1]Overview[/h1]

 [b]~ Monarch Butterfly ~[/b]
[list][*]   Caterpillar locomotion improvements

[*]   Mating interactions (snatch) made easier
[*]Mating UI improvements - cleaner and simpler

[/list]

   [list][*] [u] New feature:[/u] Super Rushdowns! A new hunting technique for all predators - Sprint all the way upto your prey and trample them over for a "Super Rushdown".

Appreciate the support of all the game's players through the past year leading up to this point of a new DoN release again :)

Though the past year has been challenging on multiple fronts, I will continue to keep building this game to the best of my abilities. I am very grateful to all of you for your goodwill, best wishes and wonderful encouragement.

notes.title: Planetary Ecology Update Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/7c415cd70353452765cd5862dd3f69c62cc30322.jpg[/img]

Drunk On Nectar's milestone [b]Planetary Ecology[/b] update has been released!

In an exciting new direction for the game, players can now [b]Create Planets[/b] and [b]Design Biome Landscapes[/b] all while learning about Planetary Ecology and Life, thus vastly enhancing its existing offering of animal life and nature simulation.

[h1]What's New[/h1]
Here's a brief gist of what this update contains :)

1. Create Planets, set basic planetary parameters like Rotation speed, Axial Tilt, etc.

2. Create landmasses, oceans and choose from various Biomes for your planet.

3. Tropical Rainforest, Grasslands, Deserts, Temperate Mixed Forests, Coniferous Forests, Polar and Oceanic are the biomes you can literally paint onto your landmassess!

4. Sculpting of landmass with simple earthing / unearthing.

5. Saving & Loading of your Planets.

6. [b]Sharing Planets[/b] is possible via exchanging planet files which begin with the name "DoN Planet"; these are present in your Saves folder.

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
There's an incredible range of possibilities from here.

Ultimately, convergence of "Planetary Ecology" into game's unique "Life Of Animals", the full-scale animal life experience, is the lofty goal. This can certainly be attained with your lovely feedback, enthusiasm and support for the game. Thank you :)

Please voice your opinion on this update in whatever manner pleases you the most! :)

[h1]Thank You[/h1]
As always, thank you for patiently waiting for this update.

It is always my sincere goal to provide more content to you in a timely fashion. As best as I can, I will continue to do so :)

Hope you enjoy the Planetary Ecology update :)

With ❤,
Venugopalan Sreedharan

notes.title: DoN's Planetary Ecology, Biomes & Plant Life focus!
notes.content:
[h1]New Roadmap![/h1]
An exciting revision to Drunk On Nectar's roadmap is now underway!

[b]Planetary Ecology[/b], [b]Biomes [/b]and [b]Plant Life[/b] are the game's new focus; these exciting additions will provide a larger context for the game's existing attractions while greatly enriching the surrounding flora, landscapes and the Nature Sandbox mode's untapped potential as well.

Your enthusiasm and ideas are greatly encouraged for this exciting new direction :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/5a5bd90f7d66c4ff7acaf4cc9ea9d89734e488d2.jpg[/img]
[i]A picture from DoN's original Dev Prototype, depicting the game's early vision :)[/i]

[h1]Background[/h1]
Thusfar Drunk On Nectar "The Nature Simulator" has provided a detailed treatment of invertebrate life, but with only minimal depiction of the larger macro level habitats which its creatures inhabit, such as landscapes, biomes or even planetary ecology.

To bridge this obvious gap between the game's larger vision (and subtitle!) and its current focus, the time was now deemed ripe to shift gears, zoom out and add broader perspectives as part of the game's already unique offering.

This will provide a larger context for the game's existing attractions while allowing a more free and relaxed growth of the game's overall natural world depiction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/94f07d59921a755aaf079d41be51e9190930b3dc.jpg[/img]
[i]Time to zoom out a bit, as our little Grasshopper (see left) clearly inferred! :)[/i]

[h1]Ideas Invited[/h1]
This initiative is still in very early stages, so there is enormous scope and interest in your own ideas, creativity and contributions. Please use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/512460/discussions/0/3681064390588107630/]this Inspirations Thread[/url] for sharing your inspirations.

Any pictures and inspirations of the Natural World/Landscapes/etc, personally taken by you are particularly welcome in this thread along with your thoughts, commentaries and suggestions :)

For those wondering what this means for the eagerly awaited Praying Mantis update, that update has currently been indefinitely postponed. The current plan is to pick up that thread again at an opportune time; I appreciate both your enthusiasm and understanding in this regard :)

[h1]Thank You![/h1]
As always, a heartfelt thanks to everyone for your patience, kindness and support in helping the game grow and thrive all these years. Please join me on this exciting new adventure by posting your inspirations in the official [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/512460/discussions/0/3681064390588107630/]Inspirations Thread[/url] :)

That's it for now, but stay tuned for more Nature Goodness!

With ❤,
Venugopalan Sreedharan
[i]Developer Of Drunk On Nectar[/i]

notes.title: ☀ Anniversary Update ☀ The Ladybug's Lifecycle, Released!
notes.content:
[h1]Celebrating Drunk On Nectar's 3rd Anniversary on Steam! :)[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/ee75bf5206d5e7cd349b757ef3452bd4bf6328ca.jpg[/img]
[b][i]Rip-roaring Carnivorous Beetle larva action is here![/i][/b]

Charming as an adult, terrifying as a larva, the most voracious insect carnivore in popular lore is here for your play!

Action-packed gameplay meets beautiful vistas and Educational narratives, making the [b]Ladybug's lifecycle release[/b] the game's most significant update yet, by far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/dd0c69596ead9721fb1c6406cab5e0f398e47a2f.jpg[/img]

Survive the most densely populated vistas ever seen in the game. Thrust amidst hoards of prey (New Species - Aphids are here!) and wily Ants, you and your siblings must journey across a blistering life experience as a tiny carnivorous larva with an enormous appetite.

[h1]The Metamorphosis of the Ladybug[/h1]
From Egg to Larva to Pupa to Winged adult, the Ladybug exhibits a "complete metamorphosis", much like the fabled Monarch Butterfly.

That's not all though, Mating & Reproduction is included too! As a female or male Ladybug find a partner, engage in courtship, lay eggs and thus complete your Gen 1 life story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/47274b3d5af50bd94fd3a344ea1a9335b6047595.jpg[/img]

Generation 1 is a carefully guided experience for new players and veterans alike, while Generation 2 (and beyond!) offer pure Sandbox gameplay with unlimited potential for exploration and emergent interactions.

[h1]Additional Features Coming Soon:[/h1]
Certain visual features are still pending, these will be added in due course:
1) Ladybug Pupa transition visuals
2) Various Colorations - before pupation, after emergence, egg shells, etc
3) Grooming & Grappling Animations etc

Gameplay wise there is also further room for expansion, however it was deemed essential to get this initial version out for your enjoyment and valuable feedback.

Please provide feedback on the things that you enjoyed or would like improved, as this update will continue to be polished over the coming days and your input is absolutely essential in realizing the full potential of this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/9c6518bf85ae592c857cc8a488ac523687e78fe1.jpg[/img]


[h1]Thank You![/h1]
I would like to take this opportunity to say Thank You! to all for your great enthusiasm, lively support and boundless patience in witnessing the unfoldment of Drunk On Nectar's joyous dream to depict Nature in a format that we love and enjoy so much.

2019 has seen several milestone releases for the game so far including the Monarch Butterfly and Jumping Spider's Mating & Reproduction, Grasshopper's Complete Lifecycle and now the Ladybug's Lifecycle too.

The obvious desire among all of us to see more new content arrive rapidly into the game is clear. That goal is now finally attainable as the game's development effort has been greatly empowered through various lessons learned in this year of 2019 and through many challenges that have been successfully overcome in developing and growing the game over the years.

So truly, a powerful creative momentum to propel the game's further growth and expansion is now strongly in place, so rest assured for Drunk On Nectar the show has only just begun! :)

With ❤,
Venugopalan Sreedharan
[i](Developer of Drunk On Nectar - The Nature Simulator)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26742086/bdb7e5e1eed1ab4aa2eaa0823185966a4e41768e.jpg[/img]
